text: I've been living in this band since 30 weeks and the weight off my lower back is unreal. I can stand at the stove again without needing to sit down every five minutes.
It lifts my bump nicely, and my lower back pain has eased by the end of the day.
It really takes the pressure off my hips, especially by the end of the day.
It gives my back solid support and keeps me sitting up straight at my desk.
It holds my belly up so it isn't hanging so low anymore, and that alone is a relief.
It's really supportive and I feel much more secure with it on.
Almost fully takes away the sciatica I've had since my second trimester.
It supports my back well, but it rolls down every time I sit.
